image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) on a rough, greyish stone surface. The amphibian has glossy black skin with distinct, irregular yellow blotches. The head is broad with visible parotoid glands. Four limbs are visible; the front right limb shows signs of digit fusion. A tail extends towards the upper left, partially out of frame. There is illegible text-like artifacting in the bottom right corner.
